stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: Her aspiration was to become an architect.
items.sentenceZh: 她的志向是成为建筑师。
items.scene: Young adult in a Chinese community design workshop studies a hand-built building model, gazing toward a translucent imagined future self working as a professional architect. Same distinctive hairstyle in present and vision; no words or logos.
items.altText: 年轻人研究建筑模型，想象自己未来成为建筑师。

items.sentenceEn: The hurricane approached the coast.
items.sentenceZh: 飓风逼近海岸。
items.scene: Wide stylized aerial view of a large spiral tropical cyclone over the ocean approaching a coastline, distinct central eye and curved cloud bands; coastal waves below, no people or graphic destruction.
items.altText: 海面上有明显风眼与螺旋云带的飓风逼近海岸。

items.sentenceEn: She aspires to become a skilled violinist.
items.sentenceZh: 她立志成为技艺娴熟的小提琴手。
items.scene: Chinese adult violin learner practices attentively at home; a small soft thought vignette of the same woman confidently playing in a concert hall shows the future goal. Focus on active pursuit, no musical notation or words.
items.altText: 小提琴学习者专注练习，想象未来登台演奏。

items.sentenceEn: The retailer sold shoes directly to customers.
items.sentenceZh: 零售商直接向顾客出售鞋子。
items.scene: Contemporary Chinese neighborhood shoe shop, retailer presents one everyday shoe to a customer beside neatly arranged small shelves of varied footwear. Clear consumer transaction, no warehouse, bulk shipping, brands or written signs.
items.altText: 社区鞋店的零售商向顾客介绍鞋子。

items.sentenceEn: The assassination of the mayor shocked the town.
items.sentenceZh: 市长遇刺身亡震惊了小镇。
items.scene: Sober fictional aftermath of a mayor’s assassination: mourners gather at a civic building beside a dignified memorial portrait of the mayor and flowers; an investigator at a cordoned adjacent doorway examines the scene. No real person or city, attacker, method, weapon, injury, body or blood. The sentence supplies event specificity; image conveys targeted loss and community shock. No writing, emblems or logos.
items.altText: 虚构小镇居民在市长遇刺后献花悼念，调查员在旁调查。

items.sentenceEn: Classify the leaves by their shape.
items.sentenceZh: 按形状给叶子分类。
items.scene: Top-down botanical sorting scene: adult hands separate collected leaves into three visibly distinct shape groups, narrow needles, rounded leaves and lobed leaves. Each group internally consistent, no labels or numbers.
items.altText: 双手把针形、圆形和分裂叶按形状分组。

items.sentenceEn: Her assertion needed supporting evidence.
items.sentenceZh: 她的断言需要证据支持。
items.scene: Community discussion, speaker makes a confident claim using a drawing of a flourishing plant; listener calmly compares it to incomplete observational sketches and asks for evidence through questioning gesture. No verified fact implied, no words, symbols or readable charts.
items.altText: 发言者提出主张，听众查看观察记录并要求证据。

items.sentenceEn: He gave her assurance that the repair would be finished.
items.sentenceZh: 他向她保证修理会完成。
items.scene: Chinese repair workshop, repairer looks customer in the eye and offers a sincere open-handed promise beside a partly repaired bicycle, organized tools and remaining task visible. Calm reassurance, no certificate, written pledge or digits.
items.altText: 修理师傅在待修自行车旁，诚恳地向顾客保证完成修理。

items.sentenceEn: The coup removed the elected government.
items.sentenceZh: 政变推翻了民选政府。
items.scene: Neutral fictional political illustration: a small group of uniformed military officials takes control of a government chamber while civilian elected officials are escorted out peacefully; an abandoned ballot box with blank papers in foreground contrasts democratic mandate with forceful takeover. No real national symbols, recognizable leaders, flags, weapon details, injuries or celebratory tone. No writing.
items.altText: 虚构场景中，军方接管议事厅，民选官员被迫离开。

items.sentenceEn: The waterfall was an astonishing sight.
items.sentenceZh: 瀑布的景象令人惊叹。
items.scene: Enormous dramatic waterfall plunges into a misty gorge, tiny adult hikers on safe overlook with wide eyes and open mouths, emphasizing immense surprising scale. No text or extreme danger.
items.altText: 巨大的瀑布落入峡谷，观景台上的人惊叹其壮观。

items.sentenceEn: The ambassador met local community leaders.
items.sentenceZh: 大使会见了当地社区领袖。
items.scene: Fictional diplomatic community meeting in a contemporary Chinese civic reception room, visiting ambassador with aides respectfully greets local leaders around a round table. No real flags, official emblems, identifiable politician or writing. Sentence establishes formal role.
items.altText: 外交来访者与社区领袖在会客室里礼貌会面。

items.sentenceEn: The family sought asylum in a safe country.
items.sentenceZh: 这家人向一个安全的国家寻求庇护。
items.scene: Displaced family at a calm reception center meets an official who listens to their request for protection; simple luggage, open doorway and sheltered waiting space convey safety. No cages, visible threat, real border markings, flags or written documents. All readable faces complete and dignified.
items.altText: 一家人在安全接待中心向工作人员申请保护。

items.sentenceEn: The atrocity left the village in mourning.
items.sentenceZh: 那场暴行使村庄陷入哀悼。
items.scene: Sober aftermath of fictional violence against civilians: village homes damaged, residents gather at a simple flower memorial while relief workers support them. No act of violence depicted, perpetrators, weapons, bodies, blood, real group emblems or identifying location. Respectful muted illustration, no text.
items.altText: 遭受暴行后的虚构村庄中，居民悼念，救援人员提供帮助。

items.sentenceEn: The density of the forest increased near the river.
items.sentenceZh: 靠近河流处，森林的密度增加了。
items.scene: Clearly stylized aerial forest illustration: two equal-area portions of the same forest, sparse trees far from river and many closely packed trees beside river. Tree size similar, equal land areas clear, no labels or digits.
items.altText: 同样大小的林地区域，河边树木更多、更密集。

items.sentenceEn: She opened the attachment in the email.
items.sentenceZh: 她打开了邮件中的附件。
items.scene: Conceptual text-free email screen with an envelope icon and clearly separate thumbnail of a flower photo connected by a paperclip; hand taps thumbnail and image opens in separate viewer. Same flower thumbnail and opened image, no readable interfaces, letters or logos.
items.altText: 邮件旁的回形针与图片缩略图表示附件，点击后图片展开。

items.sentenceEn: Her friends were supportive during the move.
items.sentenceZh: 搬家时，她的朋友们给予了支持。
items.scene: Friends help an adult move into a Chinese apartment, carry manageable boxes, offer encouraging smiles and help unpack; protagonist visibly relieved. Different complete faces, no heavy unsafe loads, brands or written box labels.
items.altText: 朋友帮忙搬箱子、整理新家，给予搬家者支持。

items.sentenceEn: The climbers attained their goal at the summit.
items.sentenceZh: 登山者在山顶实现了目标。
items.scene: Two prepared adult hikers reach a broad safe mountain summit after a winding visible trail; they look quietly pleased at the completed ascent rather than exaggerated victory pose. No cliff-edge stunt, flag, trophy or writing.
items.altText: 登山者沿山路到达宽阔山顶，平静地欣赏远景。

items.sentenceEn: Curiosity led the child to examine the seed.
items.sentenceZh: 好奇心促使孩子观察种子。
items.scene: Child in a Chinese courtyard garden leans forward with fascinated expressive face to inspect a sprouting bean seed in a transparent jar through a magnifying glass, adult nearby encourages observation. No text or exaggerated eye distortion.
items.altText: 孩子用放大镜仔细观察发芽的豆子，神情好奇。

items.sentenceEn: The editor adjusted the audio volume.
items.sentenceZh: 编辑调整了音频音量。
items.scene: Sound editing workstation with simplified blank interface showing waveform and a single unlabeled volume slider; adult editor wears headphones and adjusts control, two speaker cones beside screen. No lyrics, letters, numbers or software logo.
items.altText: 戴耳机的编辑调节音量，屏幕上有音频波形。

items.sentenceEn: The child skipped along the path.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子沿着小路蹦跳前行。
items.scene: Three successive positions of SAME child along park path showing a true step-hop skipping gait, one foot steps then hops with opposite knee lifted; light cheerful motion, no jump rope, no hazardous surface or text.
items.altText: 孩子沿公园小路一步一跳地前进，动作轻快。
